description: v0.292.0. A bonus, commission or profit-share payout paid with a pay run. Counts as earnings for garnishment caps (CCPA earnings include bonuses and commissions).

fields.label: Kind
fields.options:
Bonus
Production Bonus
Profit Share
Commission
Sick Time
Other

fields.label: Amount
fields.description: For Sick Time, left at 0 and priced by the run (OAR 839-007-0000(7)).

fields.label: Pay With The Run Covering
fields.description: Paid by the payroll run whose period includes this date.

fields.label: Earned From
fields.description: v0.296.0. The first day of the work this bonus was earned on. A non-discretionary bonus is allocated over the workweeks it was earned in and the overtime premium on it is paid with it (29 CFR 778.209). Blank: the pay period it is paid in.

fields.label: Tax Treatment
fields.description: Wages: taxed and withheld with the period's pay. Not subject to withholding: e.g. a fishing-boat crew share under IRC 3121(b)(20) — no income tax or FICA is withheld, but it still counts as earnings for garnishment (15 U.S.C. 1672(a)). Have the CPA confirm the treatment for each kind.

fields.label: Work State
fields.description: v0.293.0. Whose income tax is withheld when this item is paid on a slip with no hours. Blank: the state on the worker's most recent slip.

fields.label: Bonus Terms
fields.description: v0.302.0. What the bonus is and how it is earned — including when it is earned. Conditions not disclosed cannot be used to deny or reduce it (OAR 839-020-0013).

fields.label: Terms Posted On
fields.description: When the terms were posted where the crew could read them, in a language they read.

fields.label: Rate Evidence
fields.description: v0.307.0. How a Sick Time item's hourly rate was set — the workweek used and the calculation (WAC 296-128-670), or the Oregon rule. Written when a saved run pays it.

name: Farm Pay Item
